title.narrative: FOND. FORUM DE BAMAKO 2023: Bamako Forum
FOND. FORUM DE BAMAKO 2023: Bamako Forum

description.narrative: Forum Bamako is a yearly event with the purpose to analyse, disseminate and debate new research finding and methods to adress Mali's peace and security challenges.
Forum Bamako är ett årligt evenemang syftar till att analysera, debattera och publicera nya forskningsrön och metoder för att hantera Malis freds-och säkerhetssproblem.

To engage in discussion on local development as a factor for peace. The objective of the intervention was to promote analysis, dissemination, dialog and debate of research findings relating the peace and security challenges from the local level in Mali. The purpose was to promote analysis and exchange of ideas on how the security situation can be addressed and what could be learnt from past experiences. The themes presented as well as the exchanges around these themes will be published in writing and the recommendations of these exchanges will be shared with decisionmakers.

sector.narrative: Civilian peace-building, conflict prevention and resolution

description.narrative: It is our assessment that it would be early to talk about results if we understand that results are changes in a state or condition that derive from a cause and effect relationship. However, remaining in the principles of Results Based Management (RBM) and knowing that there are three types of such changes outputs, outcomes and impact that can be set in motion by a development intervention, we understand that a first level of results (outputs) according to RBM can be considered: the Forum gathered during 3 days 2,000 participants including 500 in face to face meetings. Various ideas were also generated that will contribute to the implementation of the Strategic Framework of the refoundation of the State. One of them was "there will never be local development as long as the State remains in a centralized management system inherited from colonization". Continuing in the same vein, the forum put forward the idea that "regionalized development which emphasizes the strengths of the regions should be highlighted in the Malian's case". For instance, the development of the Mopti region must be focused on livestock breeding, the creation of modern slaughterhouses and the creation of livestock feed manufacturing plants. The following ideas, drawn-up from the narrative report, are linked to the objectives of the 20212025 Swedish bilateral cooperation strategy with Mali and could be further developed: 1 Human rights, democracy, the rule of law and gender equality Ensuring fair and credible elections, and a rapid return to a democratically elected civilian government Taking into account young people, women and men who are the life of the territories Taking into account young people and women to drive the development of territory Strengthening citizen control Strengthening state support Conducting studies at the different levels of decentralization Soliciting the contribution of the diaspora Reviewing the local development financing system Accountability in the management of funds allocated to projects Promoting media literacy and critical thinking from an early age Drawing lessons from the implementation of results-based financing in terms of autonomy and responsibility of stakeholders, transparency and accountability in management 2 Peaceful and inclusive societies Promoting and opening space for dialog Consolidating trust between groups and communities Being sensitive to everyone's needs and perspectives Considering the existence of conflict management mechanisms Considering the plurality of territorial scales, acceptance of diversity, recognition of specificity of identity groups, diversities and traditions 3 Environment, climate and sustainable use of natural resources Accelerating the master plan in the area of water in urban areas Exploiting groundwater Carrying-out suitable drilling Implementing agribusiness project to prepare for post-operation of the mining site accompanied by a training component for qualified workers in agriculture. The mechanism for sustainability and management of the infrastructures Emphasizing human capital which must be at the heart of development and not natural resources
